description: A remaining percentage strictly below 20 starts one warning episode. New readings within it stay quiet after the warning key is claimed; a measured recovery to 20 or above re-arms it. Unknown readings prove no recovery, and re-delivered fetches produce no new edge. Each sequence starts with an empty ledger and state; all times are offsets in milliseconds from the test's fixed instant. Expected lines and episode states are handwritten.
